decision.minimal_change: Use Ui::publish_additional_bindings at the existing editor RUN_BINDINGS customization point, retaining real editor/completion publication. Existing public API documents additive same-owner bindings. Alternatively use author::extend_bindings only if explicit conflict diagnostics are required; no new input/render system or runtime priority alteration.
decision.shared_runtime_changes: None justified by these failures. Keep replacement semantics of publish_bindings because components use intentional active-map replacement.
decision.api_gap: No missing adapter for this bounded fix: Ui::publish_additional_bindings already public and preserves hints. A future typed component extension builder may improve consumer ergonomics, but is not required to resolve routing.
